Palette/material identity: layered ivory and silver archival materials, translucent memory leaves, warm amber/gold strokes and fine cyan circuitry on midnight indigo. Premium polished hand-painted2D cosmic science-fiction fantasy illustration, exquisite clean native-resolution detail, smooth material shading, crisp silhouettes and controlled luminous highlights, strong readable forms even at card size. Diverse evocative compositions with real visual depth. No grain, noisy texture, blur, pixelation, humans, text, letters, numbers, UI, borders, logos, watermarks or existing game references. Brand-new illustrations, no reused ship art. Opaque dark illustrated backgrounds, not transparent.
